reviews.text: Never leave your dog here. Never. According to Milo's family, they left him in the care of this kennel and he ended up dead after being run over by a car after leaving through the front door. This is not "a mistake" or a minor accident: it is a very serious failure that devastated a family. A place entrusted with caring for dogs cannot allow something like this to happen. After this, they should cease operations; no person or family should ever have to go through something like this again! TAKE RESPONSIBILITY.

The joy of Woof Wolf coming into our lives is incredible. The whole experience is spectacular, from the ease of booking to the wonderful way they treat the dogs upon arrival! She leaves happy, they let her play in the daycare, the service is impeccable, and if they don't have something, they'll get it for you. Nacha has a protein allergy, and they have everything from shampoo to kibble and hydrolyzed treats! I congratulate them on the excellent service and professionalism they bring to this task, which gives us parents so much peace of mind! Congratulations, everything is excellent!!!!
